caveats: Sources establish the agency as Worcester Police Department (MA) despite the 'unknown-agency' slug. Civil suit: rape victim of former officer Rajat Sharda sued Sharda, the City of Worcester, ex-City Manager O'Brien, and ex-Chief Gemme in August 2016; case moved to federal court. Per thisweekinworcester.com (Dec 2024), 'a federal judge later ordered Sharda to pay the victim $2.5 million' - a court-ordered judgment against Sharda personally, not a negotiated settlement, so outcome coded plaintiff_verdict and the $2.5M is a judgment amount; year of judgment and whether it was a default judgment are not stated. Criminal: Sharda convicted of rape and related charges (2013 incident), sentenced up to 7 years; convictions affirmed by MA Appeals Court in 2022. The 2024 DOJ pattern-or-practice findings against WPD are context only. AP News and wwlp.com sources were unreachable (skipped).
